causes_and_corrections.cause: Reused F3b runner roots assumed a shallower directory and historical 494 baseline counts.
causes_and_corrections.correction: Set N4/staged57/build paths explicitly; preserve historical 494 checks as references while G2 independently enforces 480/473/346/263/469/464 and exact 90,809,869 upper work.

causes_and_corrections.cause: Historical F3b output was being used as a candidate integer-prefix comparator.
causes_and_corrections.correction: Add reference-capture mode with no historical integer comparison; candidate mode requires a terminal, passing same-gate N4 capture and pins its stdout streams.

causes_and_corrections.cause: GQ must anchor on the third NATIVE3D_QUALITY stage=window row for each rank; quality_entry is a different marker.
causes_and_corrections.correction: Count exact window rows per rank and compare through the existing comparator’s per-rank anchor; every GQ run first passes exact G2.

causes_and_corrections.cause: Prefix runs terminate before native final summaries, so the whole-job RSS gate cannot rely on event summary rows.
causes_and_corrections.correction: Track per-process VmHWM by PID/start-tick identity, retain peaks after exit, and stop above 19,999,490,048 bytes.

causes_and_corrections.cause: The global build output may be mutable after build completion.
causes_and_corrections.correction: Execute the local-only sealed N4 reference binary and verify its SHA against both build status and original build output.

causes_and_corrections.cause: Comparator treated NATIVE3D_QUALITY debt_removed decimal measurement as an integer gate counter.
causes_and_corrections.correction: Ignore the exact floating measurement key and self-check that 0.0 versus 0.125 does not affect prefix equality.
